prompt.alinti: Okay, go to GitHub, copy this repo URL, and ask CloudCode to install it.
Install it once, and Cloud won't just write code for you anymore.
It can plan projects, manage releases, review designs, write documentation, and test everything.
Basically, you're giving CloudCode an entire set of specialized engineering roles instead of using it just to write code.
This was built by Y Combinator CEO Gary Tan.
So if you're already using CloudCode, this is something you definitely need to check out.
Check our Telegram channel for the GitHub link.
